notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Measures the effective optical zone (EOZ) on a Pentacam anterior tangential difference-map screenshot: its area, ellipse axes, retention ratio against the programmed optical zone, and how far the ablation sits from the corneal vertex and from the intended target. It does this one eye at a time or for a batch of screenshots. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
